## Full candidate integration coverage — no samples
Inventory every configured agent, MCP assignment, model, Citadel link, and Tailscale link. OpenClaw applies per-agent MCP selection; Hermes retains global MCP access.
Real tool/model requests and every link must work. Missing coverage or NOT_TESTED blocks latest promotion. Each PDF section contains the full itemized results plus a short Astra summary.

## Docker Image Update Loop
**Layout only:** business execution remains disabled; existing conditions and tagging rules are preserved. Structured result collection is attached. Astra is selected through local LiteLLM.
Decision/endpoint checkpoints use the shared **Fedora45 Step Report - LLM and PDF** sub-workflow after every business step and selected decision branch. The reporter appends to one PDF per run and returns the original result unchanged.
**True = yes/pass; false = no/fail.** Errors and timeouts must also be reported before aborting or rolling back.

## 1. Check generators first, then freeze the baseline
Update yes → read-only OpenClaw/Hermes generator prechecks → stable tags and local pull → stable Quadlets → daemon-reload without restart → unchanged baseline → generator preparation below → remaining preflight and atomic commit.

## 2. Build and custom-patch tests
Build and track the same Action run → basic container checklist → own OpenClaw/Hermes patch regressions → full agent, MCP, model, Citadel, and Tailscale integration lane.

## 3. Deploy verified latest and send the accumulated report
Pull latest and verify its digest → latest Quadlets → daemon-reload → recreate containers → health check. Success and all failure outcomes converge on the final PDF delivery.

## 4. Rollback and failure outcomes
Restore stable Quadlets → daemon-reload → recreate from stable → verify recovery. Both successful recovery and failure lead to the final report.

## 5. Bounded script repair
Validation failure → remaining-attempt gate → AI correction → deterministic verification against captured/live input and historical fixtures → review → adoption → rerun version check. Every attempt is added to the same PDF.

nodes.notes: Layout placeholder. True only when at least one component has a new version.

nodes.name: Tag current versions stable - MCP
nodes.notes: Layout placeholder. First step after update yes. Freeze the current images and repositories across the affected chain via mcp-safrano9999. Structured result recording is attached; the business adapter remains unimplemented and is NOT_TESTED.

nodes.name: Dry run and compatibility check
nodes.notes: Layout placeholder. Resolve proposed versions in isolation and check dependency compatibility. Structured result recording is attached; the business adapter remains unimplemented and is NOT_TESTED.

nodes.name: Preflight passed?
nodes.notes: Layout placeholder. Both dry run and compatibility checks must pass.

nodes.name: Commit all version pins
nodes.notes: Layout placeholder. Adopt the complete version-pin update atomically. Structured result recording is attached; the business adapter remains unimplemented and is NOT_TESTED.

nodes.name: End - no update
nodes.notes: Layout placeholder. No infrastructure changes; record the no-update outcome and send the accumulated PDF report. Structured result recording is attached; the business adapter remains unimplemented and is NOT_TESTED.

nodes.name: Trigger GitHub Action build - MCP
nodes.notes: Layout placeholder. Build the affected image chain through mcp-safrano9999 with push_latest=false and push_stable=false. Use one fixed YYYY.M.N tag throughout the run; pass it as every downstream parent tag. Record the resulting digests. Publishing flags propagate through the cascade; promotion waits for all required tests. Consume the recorded, tested OpenClaw/Hermes generator commits, not moving repository refs; abort if actual build inputs differ. Structured result recording is attached; the business adapter remains unimplemented and is NOT_TESTED.

nodes.name: Track existing build run
nodes.notes: Layout placeholder. Wait for the same run ID with a time limit. Do not dispatch duplicate builds. Structured result recording is attached; the business adapter remains unimplemented and is NOT_TESTED.

nodes.name: Build successful?
nodes.notes: Layout placeholder. Build failure or timeout routes to abort and report.

nodes.name: Tag new build latest - MCP
nodes.notes: Layout placeholder. Only after every mandatory test passes for the complete required candidate set, advance latest to each recorded candidate digest through mcp-safrano9999. No rebuild between verification and tagging. GHCR tag updates are sequential: verify the complete promoted digest set before deployment; a partial promotion blocks deployment. Structured result recording is attached; the business adapter remains unimplemented and is NOT_TESTED.

nodes.name: Test-container checklist
nodes.notes: Layout placeholder. Start an isolated test container. Check startup, services, health, ports, binaries, configuration, volumes, logs, and functional smoke tests. Full agent/MCP/model and Citadel/Tailscale integration coverage is mandatory before final acceptance. Structured result recording is attached; the business adapter remains unimplemented and is NOT_TESTED.

nodes.name: All checklist items passed?
nodes.notes: Layout placeholder. No untested or failed mandatory item may pass this gate. No retry with the same versions. Full agent/MCP/model and Citadel/Tailscale integration coverage is mandatory before final acceptance.

nodes.name: Mark image verified
nodes.notes: Layout placeholder. Record verification for the exact tested image, optionally with a verified tag. Structured result recording is attached; the business adapter remains unimplemented and is NOT_TESTED.

nodes.name: Pull verified image - MCP
nodes.notes: Layout placeholder. Pull the newly promoted latest through Smart1 via mcp-safrano9999 and confirm its digest matches the tested candidate. Structured result recording is attached; the business adapter remains unimplemented and is NOT_TESTED.

nodes.name: Recreate container with new image
nodes.notes: Layout placeholder. After the latest Quadlets and daemon reload, recreate the containers with the verified latest image. A plain podman restart does not replace the image. Structured result recording is attached; the business adapter remains unimplemented and is NOT_TESTED.

nodes.name: Post-deploy health check
nodes.notes: Layout placeholder. Check readiness and stable operation within a bounded time window. Structured result recording is attached; the business adapter remains unimplemented and is NOT_TESTED.

nodes.name: New container healthy?
nodes.notes: Layout placeholder. Failed health checks route to rollback.

nodes.name: Deployment succeeded
nodes.notes: Layout placeholder. Record successful deployment before reporting. Structured result recording is attached; the business adapter remains unimplemented and is NOT_TESTED.

nodes.name: Collect all results
nodes.notes: Layout placeholder. Finalize all step records and PDF sections in sequence for this run, including repeated repair attempts and the terminal outcome. Redact sensitive data. Structured result recording is attached; the business adapter remains unimplemented and is NOT_TESTED.

nodes.name: OpenClaw - Telegram delivery
nodes.notes: Layout placeholder. Send the final accumulated PDF through OpenClaw to the configured Telegram recipient on success, no update, abort, or rollback. Record the delivery receipt locally; do not recursively report the reporting nodes. Structured result recording is attached; the business adapter remains unimplemented and is NOT_TESTED.

nodes.name: Done
nodes.notes: Layout placeholder. Terminal outcome after reporting. Structured result recording is attached; the business adapter remains unimplemented and is NOT_TESTED.

nodes.name: Roll back to stable
nodes.notes: Layout placeholder. After restoring stable Quadlets and daemon reload, recreate containers using the frozen, locally available stable image and recorded configuration. Structured result recording is attached; the business adapter remains unimplemented and is NOT_TESTED.

nodes.name: Rollback healthy?
nodes.notes: Layout placeholder. Verify recovery; report either recovered or failed rollback.

nodes.name: Record rolled back
nodes.notes: Layout placeholder. Record recovery and the failed candidate health check. Structured result recording is attached; the business adapter remains unimplemented and is NOT_TESTED.

nodes.name: Abort - record failure
nodes.notes: Layout placeholder. Abort this attempt and always route to reporting. Preserve the previous running image when deployment has not started; include rollback failure when applicable. Structured result recording is attached; the business adapter remains unimplemented and is NOT_TESTED.

nodes.name: Capture failing script and response
nodes.notes: Layout placeholder. Capture check-versions.sh, the raw third-party response, and the validation failure without exposing secrets. Structured result recording is attached; the business adapter remains unimplemented and is NOT_TESTED.

nodes.name: Pull stable baseline - MCP
nodes.notes: Layout placeholder. Make the frozen stable digests available locally through Smart1 via mcp-safrano9999 before changing Quadlets. Structured result recording is attached; the business adapter remains unimplemented and is NOT_TESTED.

nodes.name: Generate Quadlets - stable
nodes.notes: Layout placeholder. Quadlet-only setup using existing configuration, Image=:stable, no configuration prompts and no container restart. Structured result recording is attached; the business adapter remains unimplemented and is NOT_TESTED.

nodes.name: Daemon reload - keep running containers
nodes.notes: Layout placeholder. Run systemctl --user daemon-reload as the owning user. Do not restart containers. Structured result recording is attached; the business adapter remains unimplemented and is NOT_TESTED.

nodes.name: Stable baseline ready?
nodes.notes: Layout placeholder. Confirm stable image references, locally available digests, and unchanged running container IDs, start times, and service PIDs. Failure aborts before source changes.

nodes.name: Generate Quadlets - latest
nodes.notes: Layout placeholder. After successful tests and local pull, generate Quadlets from existing configuration with Image=:latest. The resolved digest must be the verified candidate. Structured result recording is attached; the business adapter remains unimplemented and is NOT_TESTED.

nodes.name: Daemon reload - latest
nodes.notes: Layout placeholder. Run systemctl --user daemon-reload before recreating containers with the tested latest image. Structured result recording is attached; the business adapter remains unimplemented and is NOT_TESTED.

nodes.name: Restore Quadlets - stable
nodes.notes: Layout placeholder. On failed post-deploy health checks, restore the stable Quadlet image references and existing configuration. Structured result recording is attached; the business adapter remains unimplemented and is NOT_TESTED.

nodes.name: Daemon reload - rollback
nodes.notes: Layout placeholder. Reload user systemd before recreating the containers from the frozen stable baseline. Structured result recording is attached; the business adapter remains unimplemented and is NOT_TESTED.

nodes.name: Check own patches against target versions
nodes.notes: Layout placeholder. Before committing version pins, check openclaw-ephemeral, hermes-ephemeral, the openclaw-deterministic overlay, and any additional Safrano patches against the proposed upstream versions. Record source commits and artifact digests, validate patch application and expected configuration/schema/API interfaces in isolation. No silent patch omission or incompatible overlay reuse. Structured result recording is attached; the business adapter remains unimplemented and is NOT_TESTED.

nodes.name: Own patches compatible?
nodes.notes: Layout placeholder. Every applicable custom patch/generator must have a passing compatibility result for the proposed upstream version. Failure or NOT_TESTED blocks the commit and build.

nodes.name: Test own patches in candidate container
nodes.notes: Layout placeholder. Run deterministic regression tests of the actual patched OpenClaw and Hermes in the candidate container: ENV-to-config generation, defaults, services, persistence/migrations, tool invocation, and MCP selection. OpenClaw keeps per-agent MCP selection; Hermes exposes all configured MCP servers. Use isolated fixtures and recorded patch refs, without changing production state. Structured result recording is attached; the business adapter remains unimplemented and is NOT_TESTED.

nodes.name: Own patch regressions passed?
nodes.notes: Layout placeholder. All applicable OpenClaw/Hermes integration and custom-patch checks must pass for this exact image digest. Failure or NOT_TESTED blocks verified/latest promotion and deployment.

nodes.name: Check openclaw-ephemeral first
nodes.notes: Layout placeholder. First read-only compatibility check when OpenClaw changes; otherwise record NOT_APPLICABLE. Test the exact generator commit against the target runtime in isolation: generated config, default-model inheritance, per-agent MCP assignments, plugins and scheduling. Preserve current-version compatibility. Record PASS, INCOMPATIBLE, or ERROR/NOT_TESTED and exact versions/commit. No source edits or tag changes here. Structured result recording is attached; the business adapter remains unimplemented and is NOT_TESTED.

nodes.name: Check hermes-ephemeral first
nodes.notes: Layout placeholder. Read-only compatibility check when Hermes changes; otherwise record NOT_APPLICABLE. Test hermes-ephemeral against the exact target Hermes runtime: ENV/config generation, models, global enabled-MCP access and systemd integration. Preserve current-version compatibility. Record PASS, INCOMPATIBLE, or ERROR/NOT_TESTED and exact versions/commit. No source edits or tag changes here. Structured result recording is attached; the business adapter remains unimplemented and is NOT_TESTED.

nodes.name: Ephemeral prechecks completed?
nodes.notes: Layout placeholder. Continue only if every changed upstream has a conclusive PASS or INCOMPATIBLE result. NOT_APPLICABLE is valid only for an unchanged component. Missing inputs, errors and NOT_TESTED abort and report. Known incompatibilities are repaired only after the stable baseline is secured.

nodes.name: Ephemeral generators compatible?
nodes.notes: Layout placeholder. All changed components must have PASS for the exact proposed generator commits and upstream versions, including current-version regression coverage. Incompatible results enter the bounded correction loop. Any changed source invalidates its prior result. No missing or NOT_TESTED result can pass.

nodes.name: Publish tested ephemeral latest - MCP
nodes.notes: Layout placeholder. After all affected generators pass and their baselines are frozen, publish tested commits on main and move each standalone generator repository Git latest tag to its tested commit through mcp-safrano9999. Apply only to changed upstream components, even when no generator correction was needed. Record exact commits. Reject intervening source changes; never move Fedora image latest in this step. Structured result recording is attached; the business adapter remains unimplemented and is NOT_TESTED.

nodes.name: Ephemeral publication verified?
nodes.notes: Layout placeholder. Verify every affected remote main and peeled Git latest tag equals its recorded tested commit. Persist the complete immutable build-input set. Partial publication or mismatch aborts before image builds. The future build adapter must consume these exact commits instead of fetching moving main/latest; current prepare-build-context.sh still needs this wiring.

parameters.content:
## Prepare tested generator sources before image builds
Use the first checks: compatible → publish main + Git latest; incompatible → bounded Astra correction → deterministic target/current-version retest.
Both OpenClaw and Hermes must pass when both change. Freeze stable before corrections; protected SOT still needs Telegram main Go.
Verify the complete published source set and build from those exact commits. Fedora image latest remains gated by all candidate tests. Each step and repair attempt updates the PDF.
